styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF and cool mist #E6EBF0 for packshot and spec screens, deep navy #14304F for grid and closing framing, honest in-context surfaces for scene shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool neutral studio light with a soft front-left key and white bounce fill, real contact shadows that ground the textile; in-scene shots on 5200-5600K daylight with one consistent direction
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pale board #E6EBF0, dark gloss panel #101418, cool glass and brushed steel for in-use contexts
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, short headline chips and small pill labels only, never dense body copy
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in deep navy #14304F, most of them left as blank slots
styleLock.presentationRules: folded textile geometry stays squared to frame, consistent product scale across the set, no floating fabric without a contact shadow
noDrift: no legible brand wordmarks or badge artwork
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium utilitarian home-cleaning visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, cool mist grey-blue #E6EBF0, deep navy structure #14304F and one signal-red accent #D9252B; cool neutral studio light with a soft front-left key, white bounce fill and honest contact shadows, in-scene shots holding one consistent 5200-5600K daylight direction; modern geometric sans-serif with short headline chips only; thin single-weight line icons in deep navy #14304F; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements such as blank measurement brackets, circular magnifier insets and empty proof chips; stable folded-textile geometry and consistent product scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no legible brand wordmarks.

provenance.notes: 八张源主图逐图事实：001 纯白底多条整齐叠码、顶条自然垂坠搭过棱角；002 双手在胸前把布撑平对镜头、左右双向尺寸箭头与左列三枚细线图标（数值与图标字样不入稿）；003 双栏同框对比、左右各一枚圆形放大镜框与栏底勾叉主张列；004 深蓝底六格场景宫格（洗碗、屏幕、台面、家具、镜窗、车轮），每格下缘一枚圆角标签；005 车内坐姿擦拭中控亮面、左下圆形放大插图与右下一排细线图标；006 手部在深色亮面车灯上擦拭、织面引出一枚细线图标；007 四格买家秀宫格（车辆、家具、厨房、窗面）、中央菱形徽标位；008 商用前开门洗衣机滚筒内织物转动、右侧大图标与两行主张字。品类判定依据：源提示为清洁布套装，套图语言以无电无电机的小件纺织清洁用品为主，场景格中厨房与家居面占多数、车辆仅为其中一格，故判为家居日用-纸品清洁而非汽车用品；leaf 取超细纤维锁边多表面清洁布，与库内华夫格织纹厨房抹布款在语义（超纤起绒加锁边、跨表面擦拭）上区分。已剥离内容：原品牌字标与菱形徽标、图内全部英文原句与图标字样（洗涤次数、尺寸数值、克重与倍数、吸水与柔软主张、可机洗与不掉色字样、格标签词）、原平台店铺字样与评分促销角标、可辨识模特面容与发饰手部饰品、洗衣机控制面板段码读数；片数与所有事实数值不入稿，规格与凭证位一律留空或以占位符承载，产品全程以 {product} 占位。
